MISTAKE, caught and left as-is: `git commit -m ...` with no pathspec commits the WHOLE staged index, not just what this call's own `git add` touched. Another agent had Server/browser.mjs (+pid() export), Server/browser-check.mjs (new file) and Servex/Servex.js already staged in this shared main tree, and ca4aae47 swept them in under my unrelated commit message. Checked: all three are syntactically valid and look complete (node --check clean, the diff is a finished-looking pid() getter), so nothing is broken or lost — just mis-attributed. Not unwinding it (reset/checkout here would risk real damage for a cosmetic fix). Lesson for the next commit: `git commit -- <exact paths>` restricts the commit to only those paths regardless of what else is staged.
